prompt.project_info: A tight sunlit beauty portrait with a sculpted dark bun, silver eye makeup, and warm bedroom shadows.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with fair warm-toned skin, dark-brown hair in a loose high bun, two straight face-framing strands, and a few styled damp-look strands across her forehead. Her light-grey contact lenses and silver shimmer eyeshadow are paired with understated neutral lips and small pearl earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level head-and-shoulders portrait on a white upholstered chair in a warm bedroom. She wears a structured ivory high-neck blouse and a single pearl necklace; hands stay outside frame. No text, logos, or watermarks.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong directional morning window light at approximately 4700K creates defined but soft-edged facial and hair shadows. Retain natural pores, controlled makeup sparkle, realistic fabric texture, and a muted warm background.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at f/2, square crop, sharp eyes, soft bed and wood background bokeh, Kodak Portra 400-inspired warmth, fine grain.

Light-grey contact lenses, reflective silver shimmer eyeshadow, natural neutral lips, small pearl earrings, a structured ivory high-neck blouse, and a single pearl necklace.
